arxiv-2308-12680.title: Master-slave Deep Architecture for Top- K K Multi-armed Bandits with Non-linear Bandit Feedback and Diversity Constraints
arxiv-2308-12680.creator: Hanchi Huang, Li Shen, Deheng Ye, Wei Liu
arxiv-2308-12680.description: Abstract We propose a novel master-slave architecture to solve the top- K K combinatorial multi-armed bandits problem with non-linear bandit feedback and diversity constraints, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first combinatorial bandits setting considering diversity constraints under bandit feedback.

arxiv-2405-07806.title: A Decentralized and Self-Adaptive Approach for Monitoring Volatile Edge Environments
arxiv-2405-07806.creator: Shashikant Ilager, Jakob Fahringer, Alessandro Tundo, Ivona Brandić
arxiv-2405-07806.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shashikant Ilager, Jakob Fahringer, Alessandro Tundo, Ivona Brandić. Edge computing provides resources for IoT workloads at the network edge. Monitoring systems are vital for efficiently managing resources and application workloads by collecting, storing, and providing relevant information about the state of the resources.

arxiv-2411-09003.title: Refusal in LLMs is an Affine Function
arxiv-2411-09003.creator: Thomas Marshall, Adam Scherlis, Nora Belrose
arxiv-2411-09003.description: Abstract We propose affine concept editing (ACE) as an approach for steering language models’ behavior by intervening directly in activations. We begin with an affine decomposition of model activation vectors and show that prior methods for steering model behavior correspond to subsets of terms of this decomposition.

arxiv-2509-26248.title: On Boolean PCSPs with Polynomial Threshold Polymorphisms
arxiv-2509-26248.creator: Katzper Michno
arxiv-2509-26248.description: Abstract In pursuit of a deeper understanding of Boolean Promise Constraint Satisfaction Problems ( 𝖯𝖢𝖲𝖯 \mathsf{PCSP} s), we identify a class of problems with restricted structural complexity, which could serve as a promising candidate for complete characterization. Specifically, we investigate the class of 𝖯𝖢𝖲𝖯 \mathsf{PCSP} s whose polymorphisms are Polynomial Threshold Functions ( 𝖯𝖳𝖥 \mathsf{PTF} s) of bounded degree.

arxiv-2510-05069.title: SwiReasoning: Switch-Thinking in Latent and Explicit for Pareto-Superior Reasoning LLMs
arxiv-2510-05069.creator: Dachuan Shi, Abedelkadir Asi, Keying Li, Xiangchi Yuan, Leyan Pan, Wenke Lee, Wen Xiao
arxiv-2510-05069.description: Abstract Recent work shows that, beyond discrete reasoning through explicit chain-of-thought steps, which are limited by the boundaries of natural languages, large language models (LLMs) can also reason continuously in latent space, allowing richer information per step and thereby improving token efficiency.

arxiv-2603-05277.creator: Anders G Frøseth

plos-pone-0005399.creator: Stefanie Widder, Javier Macía, Ricard Solé
plos-pone-0005399.description: PLOS ONE research article. Genetic toggle switches are widespread in gene regulatory networks (GRN). Bistability, namely the ability to choose among two different stable states, is an essential feature of switching and memory devices. Cells have many regulatory circuits able to provide bistability that end

pmc-10688581.title: Spinal cord compression secondary to intraspinal extramedullary hematopoiesis
pmc-10688581.creator: Foziah J. AlShamrani, Noor M. AlMohish, Fahad A. AlDawsari, Jaafer J. AlObaid, Ibrahim A. AlGhanimi, Abdullah A. AlNahdi
pmc-10688581.description: Extramedullary hematopoiesis (EMH) is a rare cause of spinal cord compression (SCC) occurring in various hematological illnesses such as myeloproliferative disorders, thalassemias, and various types of anemia. EMH represents the growth of blood cells outside the bone marrow. Common EMH locations include the spleen, liver, lymph nodes, and paravertebral regions.

pmc-11453674.title: 8006 Feedback For Fellows: Opening The Pandora's Box Of "Confidence" In Feedback
pmc-11453674.creator: Sonia Ananthakrishnan, Craig Noronha
pmc-11453674.description: Disclosure: S. Ananthakrishnan: None. C. Noronha: None. Background: Feedback is a key component of training at any level. Sub-specialty fellowship training has unique goals and barriers to feedback exchange, such as faculty tension with giving negative feedback to potential future colleagues, that are uncommon in other training environments.

pmc-11468980.title: CLIC5 promotes myoblast differentiation and skeletal muscle regeneration via the BGN-mediated canonical Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway
pmc-11468980.creator: Xin Zhang, Linjuan He, Liqi Wang, Yubo Wang, Enfa Yan, Boyang Wan, Qiuyu Zeng, Pengguang Zhang, Xingbo Zhao, Jingdong Yin
pmc-11468980.description: Myoblast differentiation plays a vital role in skeletal muscle regeneration. However, the protein-coding genes controlling this process remain incompletely understood. Here, we showed that chloride intracellular channel 5 (CLIC5) exerts a critical role in mediating myogenesis and skeletal muscle regeneration.

pmc-11517923.title: Association of Altitude with Mortality among Patients with Hypertension - A Cohort Study
pmc-11517923.creator: J Lu, L Pang, Y Xia, Z Guo, W Yang, L Duo, Q Zhu, T Wang
pmc-11517923.description: BackgroundAvailable evidence falls short in assessing the risk of all-cause mortality and cardiovascular disease (CVD) mortality among individuals with hypertension residing at various altitudes. This study’s objective was to investigate the correlation between residential altitude and the rates of all-cause mortality and CVD mortality among hypertensive patients.

pmc-11533547.title: Peptide-directed interference of PD-1/PD-L1 binding increases B lymphocyte function after infectious bursal disease viral infection
pmc-11533547.creator: Qiuyu Zhang, Guopeng Sun, Feng Yue, Zhike Liu, Peng Li, Yanping Zhu, Yangzhao Zhu, Ruiyan Niu, Zilong Sun, Xuannian Wang, Gaiping Zhang
pmc-11533547.description: Programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1)/PD-1 ligand 1 (PD-L1) binding contributes to immune evasion mechanisms responsible for B lymphocyte exhaustion and apoptosis. This facilitates immunosuppression in chronic viral infections, including infectious bursal disease virus (IBDV). Our previous study showed that PD-1 and PD-L1 expression increases in the peripheral blood mononuclear cells of chickens infected with IBDV.

pmc-11641697.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Expression Analysis of ACA/ECAs in Capsicum annuum L.
pmc-11641697.creator: Yuxuan Qian, Jing Tong, Ning Liu, Baoju Wang, Zhanhui Wu
pmc-11641697.description: Pepper (Capsicum annuum L.) is a popular vegetable in people’s daily lives. During pepper growth, calcium (Ca) is an essential macronutrient, and calcium-transporting ATPase (ACA/ECA) is a vital protein for calcium transport. However, reports on the ACA/ECA gene family in the pepper genome are lacking. Hence, we used various bioinformatics methods to identify the ACA/ECA gene family in pepper.

pmc-11657023.title: Cognitive Impact of β‐Amyloid Load in the Rapid Eye Movement Sleep Behavior Disorder–Lewy Body Disease Continuum
pmc-11657023.creator: Kyung Ah Woo, Eun Jin Yoon, Seoyeon Kim, Heejung Kim, Ryul Kim, Bora Jin, Seungmin Lee, Hyunwoong Park, Hyunwoo Nam, Yu Kyeong Kim, Jee‐Young Lee
pmc-11657023.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundRapid eye movement sleep behavior disorder (RBD) is linked to the diffuse‐malignant subtype and higher cognitive burden in Lewy body disease (LBD).ObjectiveThis study explores brain β‐amyloid deposition and its association with cognitive decline across the RBD–LBD continuum.MethodsPatients with isolated RBD (iRBD), Parkinson's disease with probable RBD (PDRBD), and dementia with Lewy bodies with probable RBD (DLBRBD) underwent 18F‐florbetaben positron emission tomography, 3T magnetic resonance imaging scans, and comprehensive neuropsychological assessments.

pmc-11713086.title: Automated Brain Volumetry Analysis for Differential Diagnosis of Frontotemporal Dementia Subtypes
pmc-11713086.creator: Hyeonwoo Cho, Mina Park, Seung Hyun Lee, Wooseok Jung, Dong‐Hee Kim, Jinyoung Kim, Yeha Lee
pmc-11713086.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundClinical diagnosis of frontotemporal dementia (FTD) can be challenging, requiring an accurate tool dedicated to this diagnostic hurdle. Since FTD exhibits distinct regional atrophy patterns on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), AI‐aided automated brain volume analysis could enhance the clinical diagnostic assessment of FTD, including the detection of the disease and the classification of subtypes, which encompass behavioral variant (BV), semantic variant (SV), and progressive non‐fluent aphasia (PNFA).

pmc-12435484.title: CLDN6 induces chemoresistance through protective autophagy in breast cancer
pmc-12435484.creator: Huinan Qu, Qiu Jin, Mingzi Zhang, Da Qi, Minghao Sun, Yuan Dong, Chengshi Quan
pmc-12435484.description: Protective autophagy, a defensive response of cancer cells to chemotherapeutic stress, plays a critical role in the development of chemoresistance. Our previous research has demonstrated that the tight junction protein Claudin-6 (CLDN6) can induce autophagy and chemoresistance respectively. However, it remains unclear whether CLDN6 triggers protective autophagy under chemotherapeutic conditions.

pmc-12461975.title: Co-regulation between young deaf and hard-of-hearing children and their caregivers: study protocol of Calming Together
pmc-12461975.creator: Nikki Smit, Amy Szarkowski, Hedwig JA van Bakel, Anat Zaidman-Zait, Evelien Dirks
pmc-12461975.description: BackgroundChildren who are deaf and hard-of-hearing (DHH) often experience more difficulties with self-regulation than their typical hearing peers. Self-regulation develops partly through internalization of regulation strategies provided by their caregivers during co-regulation. Co-regulation is a dynamic process through which caregivers and children influence and regulate each other’s emotions and physiological responses.

pmc-12644367.title: Keratin 80 serves as a potential biomarker in metastatic breast cancer
pmc-12644367.creator: Feng Sun, Dan Wang, Mengmeng Chen, Xiaona Lin
pmc-12644367.description: BackgroundBreast cancer (BC) is the most common type of female cancer with alarmingly high morbidity and mortality, especially metastatic BC (mBC).ObjectiveOur object is to explore a potential prognostic biomarker for mBC. The RNA-seq data of BC were downloaded from The Cancer Genome Atlas and Gene Expression Omnibus databases.

pmc-13218006.title: Evaluation of the validity and reliability of the Meloq EasyBase force platform for assessing jump performance and balance parameters
pmc-13218006.creator: Sena Gizem Arslan, Birgul Dingirdan Gultekinler
pmc-13218006.description: BackgroundForce platforms are widely used to assess postural stability and vertical jump performance, yet their cost and limited portability restrict routine clinical and field-based use. The Meloq EasyBase force platform offers a practical alternative, but its validity and reliability require investigation.

pmc-13247073.title: Co-delivering macrophage engager mRNA and PD-L1 antibody via tumor-responsive nanoparticles for glioblastoma immunotherapy
pmc-13247073.creator: Haoge Zhang, Jia Miao, Lin Gao, Xuhong Yang, Zhengcheng Yun, Lei Dong, Wanqing Cheng, Yuqi Wang, Hui Yang, Ying Zhou, Yini Zhu, Jinbing Xie
pmc-13247073.description: Bispecific immune cell engagers, particularly bispecific T-cell engagers, show limited efficacy in solid tumors such as glioblastoma (GBM) due to systemic toxicities, poor T cell infiltration, and restricted drug penetration. We develop PL@mBiME, a multifunctional lipid nanoparticle (LNP) platform that enables brain tumor–targeted delivery and sustained in vivo expression of mRNA encoding a bispecific macrophage engager (BiME).

pmc-13250020.title: Regional variation in healthcare utilization among patients with depression in Germany: a multilevel analysis with PopGrouper-based multimorbidity adjustment
pmc-13250020.creator: Anika Kreutzberg, Chrissa Tsatsaronis, Wilm Quentin, Reinhard Busse
pmc-13250020.description: BackgroundDepression is associated with a substantial health and economic burden and shows pronounced regional variation in Germany. While socioeconomic and urban–rural differences in depression prevalence and service use are well documented, less is known about how regional socioeconomic deprivation and urbanization relate to healthcare utilization after accounting for multimorbidity.

pmc-13255346.title: Genotypic and phenotypic features of 23 Egyptian patients with tuberous sclerosis complex
pmc-13255346.creator: Amr A. Othman, Abdelrahim A. Sadek, Mohammed A. Aladawy, Shereen Philip Aziz, Ahmed Sedky, Tarek M.M. Mansour, Mohammed M.S. Younis, Rania G. Abdelatif, Abd El-Monem M. Hassan, Marwa Ali Aboelmagd, Marwa Mohamed, Kawashty R. Mohamed, Salma Mohamed Elkousy, Nada M. Montaser Elkady, Rin Khang, Seung Woo Ryu, Elsayed Abdelkreem

pmc-13363379.title: Magnetic Graphene Composites: From Rational Synthesis, Structural Design to Multifunctional Applications
pmc-13363379.creator: Yanlong Liang, Pengfei Tian, Wei Wang, Shan Jin, Yun Zhao, Ruyi Li, Guiru Ma, Canliang Ma
pmc-13363379.description: Magnetic graphene composites have emerged as a frontier material platform, offering designable properties and multifunctional integration across environmental, biomedical, electromagnetic, and energy applications. Despite extensive research, a coherent knowledge framework that systematically connects synthesis, structure, property, and application remains lacking. This review addresses this gap by establishing an integrated “synthesis–structure–property–application” design paradigm.

pmc-13452419.title: Associations between active and passive social media use and anxious affect among adolescents around the world
pmc-13452419.creator: Jean M Twenge, Lindsey Rodriguez, Tamun Hanjra, Shanting Chen, Alana Rio, Alexis Diomino
pmc-13452419.description: Previous research has provided conflicting answers about whether the active use of social media, rather than just passive use, is linked to poor mental health. In addition, few studies have examined associations between social media use and mental health in international samples.

pmc-13579095.title: Apolipoprotein E DNA Methylation Linked to Cognitive Decline in Postmenopausal Women With Breast Cancer
pmc-13579095.creator: Emily K. Mewborn, Lacey W. Heinsberg, Myeong‐ga Cho, Kirk I. Erickson, Catherine M. Bender, Yvette P. Conley
pmc-13579095.description: BackgroundCognitive decline is common among individuals with breast cancer (BC), and carriage of the apolipoprotein E (APOE) ε4 allele increases risk. APOE DNA methylation (DNAm) may influence cognition through regulation of neuroinflammatory and amyloid‐related pathways. Exercise is a potential factor affecting DNAm and cognition.

pmc-13661280.title: The oral microbiome is associated with stress, adversity, and mental health in young adults
pmc-13661280.creator: Naomi N Gancz, Paul W Savoca, Bridget L Callaghan
pmc-13661280.description: Acute stress responsivity and early-life adversity are both associated with oral microbiome differences that lead to increased mental and physical health risk. However, the joint association of stress responsivity and early adversity with the oral microbiome is not yet understood.
